known_facts_book1: Arrives at Ozma's party as the most dearly beloved and important guest, so that all present rise and bow before his name is announced.
Is round as an apple with a white bushy beard, a red ermine-trimmed cloak, and a basket of presents for Ozma.
Brings with him a band of Ryls from the Happy Valley and a dozen crooked Knooks from the Forest of Burzee.
Knows Dorothy, seeing her every Christmas Eve while she sleeps, and knows Button-Bright's home.
Whispers to the Wizard where Button-Bright lives and promises to tell Polychrome's father where she is.
Rides the Saw-Horse about the Emerald City and in the procession because he is fat and short of breath.
Leaves at the end floating home inside one of the Wizard's soap-bubbles, with smaller bubbles for his Ryls and Knooks, having left his reindeer at home.

known_relations_book1.Dorothy: The girl he visits every Christmas Eve and greets fondly at the party.
known_relations_book1.Button-Bright: The boy whose home he knows and whose father he supplies at Christmas.
known_relations_book1.Ryls: The flower-painting sprites he brings along from the Happy Valley.
known_relations_book1.Knooks: The tree-tending sprites he brings from the Forest of Burzee.
known_relations_book1.Polychrome: Whose father he promises to notify so she can be fetched home.

known_facts_book1: A gingerbread man baked to a lovely brown, with white frosting shirt-front and licorice-drop buttons, who carries a candy cane.
Announced as King Dough the First, Ruler of the Two Kingdoms of Hiland and Loland, a foreign guest at Ozma's party.
Arrives with his Head Booleywag, Chick the Cherub, and their friend Para Bruin the rubber bear.
Brings Ozma a gingerbread crown set with pearls as a birthday present.
Worries anxiously that his hosts might be fond of gingerbread, and is reassured by the Scarecrow.
Sits on a golden throne at the banquet and floats home in one of the Wizard's bubbles.

known_relations_book1.Chick the Cherub: His Head Booleywag, who arrives and travels with him.
known_relations_book1.Para Bruin: The rubber bear who is their faithful friend.
known_relations_book1.Ozma: The Ruler whose birthday he attends as a foreign king.
known_relations_book1.Dorothy: The Princess who introduces him to the company.

known_facts_book1: Announced as His Serene and Tremendous Majesty, King Bud of Noland, a foreign guest at Ozma's party.
Arrives together with his sister the Princess Fluff and their friend Queen Zixi of Ix, whose kingdoms adjoin.
Is so frank and boyish that Button-Bright takes to him as a chum at once.
Brings splendid gifts for Ozma and floats home to Noland in one of the Wizard's bubbles.

known_relations_book1.Princess Fluff: His sister, who travels and departs with him.
known_relations_book1.Queen Zixi: The friendly neighboring queen he travels with.
known_relations_book1.Button-Bright: The boy who befriends him as a chum at the party.
known_relations_book1.Ozma: The Ruler whose birthday he honors.
